description: The chart illustrates sample counts for two categories, “Open” and “Cons.”, across multiple essay genres. The genre categories are arranged along the horizontal axis (labels visible include “Narrative,” “Descriptive,” and “Expository,” with an additional leftmost genre label partially out of frame), while the vertical axis is labeled “Sample Count” and uses a linear numeric scale with tick marks shown at regular intervals (approximately every 20 units) spanning from about 20 up to at least 120. For each genre, two adjacent vertical bars are shown as a grouped pair: a light blue bar for “Open” and a light pink bar for “Cons.”, with bold numeric value labels placed above each bar. The visible bar values are approximately 79 (Open, blue) and 122 (Cons., pink) for the leftmost visible genre; 80 (Open) and 87 (Cons.) for “Narrative”; 68 (Open) and 100 (Cons.) for “Descriptive”; and 62 (Open) for “Expository,” while the corresponding pink “Cons.” bar for “Expository” extends beyond the top of the visible plotting area so its exact labeled value is not fully shown. The bars are not visually stacked; they are grouped side-by-side within each genre, and no special highlighting beyond the color legend and the numeric annotations is present.
